detail: Full summary: Retrieval confirmed as Twining's weakest subsystem by independent code read: no BM25/TF-IDF anywhere, keyword fallback is substring includes() with log-TF and x0.5 discount (src/embeddings/search.ts:212-249), semantic channel capped at 10 candidates per store (search.ts:41,122), MiniLM-384 vs memsearch's benchmarked bge-m3 ONNX int8 (en R@5 0.814 vs OpenAI 0.767). memsearch's hybrid dense+BM25+RRF(k=60) fused in-store is the reference design.
